svg.aria-label: Menubar architecture: sliding highlight, floating panel handoff, exploded layers, dimensions and variable tables

g.text: BAR IS ONE TAB STOP; ARROWS MOVE FOCUS.
OPEN MENUS HAND OVER ON HOVER OR ARROWS.
HUG TRIGGERS; WIDTHS FOLLOW CALLER CONTENT.
TRACK SCROLLS ON ITS ORIENTATION AXIS.
OPEN STATE OWNS ITS MEASURED BOX.
PANEL MOVES AND RESIZES; ROWS CROSS-FADE.
OUTGOING COPY IS INERT AND CLIPPED.
REDUCED MOTION USES A SHORT CSS SWAP.
SCALE 1:1 · MD · WIDTHS / ROW COUNT SCHEMATIC

HIGHLIGHT: TRANSLATE + WIDTH + HEIGHT; RADIUS IS NOT SCALED.
box B origin − box A origin
One production demo; five menu branches. All size / orientation branches audited.
PANEL ROW R4 IS SOURCE RADIUS; R5 IS A REFERENCE.
A / B / I SUFFIXES IDENTIFY CALLER INSTANCES.
